map_info.name: Vectors_Act4a_KineticForces
map_info.title: Kinetic Forces
map_info.description: Three measured drag probes and a separately controlled walking adapter open the hall. The mower compares signed nominal work with an irreversible cut lawn; the ring compares speed and centripetal acceleration on a prescribed circle.

learning_objectives: Compare physical linear drag at equal initial speed and different mass
Distinguish physical drag from a locomotion adapter
Compare signed nominal work, path and persistent cutting
Relate prescribed circular speed to required inward acceleration

intro.text: Three equal launches. Watch what changes before revealing the rule.
intro.speaker: Act IV

truth_work.text: Bring the mower back without turning it. Which records return with it?
truth_work.speaker: Work

truth_drag.text: AIR, WATER, HONEY: chosen coefficients, one drag rule. Increase mass and try again.
truth_drag.speaker: Drag

truth_projectile.text: A launch gives velocity. Inspect which update carries it onward.
truth_projectile.speaker: Projectile

truth_centripetal.text: Double the speed on this prescribed circle. How much inward acceleration does that path require?
truth_centripetal.speaker: Centripetal

truth_gravity.text: A circular picture alone does not tell you how the orbit was computed.
truth_gravity.speaker: Gravity

truth_kinetic.text: Applied force, nominal work, required acceleration: which body receives each rule, and what does it retain?
truth_kinetic.speaker: Reflection
